zh.title: Norse Atlantic暫停11月26日所有航班
zh.summary: Norse Atlantic暫停11月26日所有航班，並警告可能聲請破產。
body: Norse Atlantic表示，若無法緊急取得短期融資方案，董事會打算聲請破產。該公司11月25日曾警告，財務狀況「危急」。
停航時，Norse Atlantic營運7條航線，其中5條飛往泰國。另有2條航線原訂12月開航，分別連接曼徹斯特與曼谷，以及倫敦蓋威克機場與普吉島。
Norse Atlantic在週四上午的聲明中，未提供退款或替代航班的細節。

en.title: Norse Atlantic suspends all flights scheduled for November 26
en.summary: Norse Atlantic suspends all November 26 flights and warns it could file for bankruptcy.
body: Norse Atlantic said its board intended to file for bankruptcy if a short-term financing solution was not secured urgently. On November 25, the airline had warned that its financial situation was ‘critical’.

At the time of the suspension, Norse Atlantic was operating seven routes, five of them to Thailand. Two more had been due to launch in December, connecting Manchester with Bangkok and London Gatwick (LGW) with Phuket.
In its Thursday morning statement, Norse gave no details about refunds or alternative flights.
